goal: Check a container image before it ships: base image, running user, secrets and scan results.
use: Check a container image before it ships: base image, running user, secrets and scan results. Use when a Dockerfile or image build changes.

steps.note: Read the Dockerfile. Note the base image, its tag, the build stages and the final command.
Check the base image. Flag untagged or latest base images, and images no longer supported.
Check the user. Flag images that run as root with no reason.
Check secrets. Flag secrets copied into the image or passed as build arguments that stay in the layers.
Check the scan. Note the image scan result.
Report. A pass or fail verdict, with each finding, its file and line, and the fix.
